Workflow: Build the PUBO from the sequence length, solve with Quicopt v0.2.
Hardware Specifications: AMD EPYC-Rome, 255 vCPUs, 503 GB RAM; Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, Linux 6.8.0, x86-64
Remarks: A run has two parts. Work done for that run alone takes 153 s wall and 1840 s CPU on average. A preparation step, shared by all 5 runs of this instance, takes 338 s wall and 16900 s CPU. The runtimes above charge that shared step to every run, so they say what one sequence costs from a cold start, and they do not shrink as more runs are added. All 5 runs together actually used 26099 s CPU. That is less than 5 times CPU Runtime, because the shared step ran once rather than 5 times and the runs ran side by side. Successful runs are those that reached the reported objective exactly.
